Stories & Poems
THE NIGHT BEFORE THE NIGHT BEFORE CHRISTMAS
BY PEPPY PEPPERMINT
'Tis the night before Christmas Eve at the North Pole. The elves are rushing to meet their goal. Santa's preparing for his Christmas Eve ride, Checking the weather and watching the tide.
The reindeer have paused their reindeer play To rest and get ready to pull Santa's sleigh. Rudolph is polishing up his red nose; He wants to be sure that it lights up and glows.
Soon in the workshop they hear a loud bell. The elves met their deadline! All is well. The toys are finished, but jobs are not done. Packing the sleigh is the next round of fun.
Santa checks each toy and fills it with toys— Gift wrapped and ready for girls and boys. Soon the bag is full but there's still too much to lift. So they call on the Yeti to help assist.
